name: find_niches
description: Suggest online store niches from a hand-curated list, matched to the user's interests and starting budget. Qualitative reasoning only, not market data.

name: get_launch_checklist
description: Return a step-by-step checklist for launching an online store (plan, setup, products, legal, launch, growth).

name: calculate_profit
description: Calculate profit per sale, margin, break-even price and maximum ad cost per sale for a product. Any fee value not supplied uses an EXAMPLE default that the user must verify for their plan and country.

name: get_shopify_signup_link
description: Get the link the user can use to start a Shopify store.
